request.description: Original OVERDRIVE arcade combat HUD font, crisp Sega Genesis / Mega Drive 16-bit military action lettering. Highly legible compact squared condensed capital letters and numerals, strong 2-pixel vertical stems, flat tops, small chamfered corners and restrained racing-cut terminals. Numerals 0 and 8 must clearly differ. White solid glyph faces with a subtle light silver top edge and dark navy one-pixel outline. No glow, no blur, no texture noise, no large serifs, no decorative marks detached from letters. Consistent baseline, cap height and stroke thickness. Designed for small ammo, action status, SCORE and HIGH SCORE text. Include clear equals, hyphen, slash and X characters.

Only these THREE components.
